test_results.test_strategy: Each test independently reloads inputs and re-runs engine logic to guarantee isolation

performance_observation.observation: Long runtime observed (~29 minutes for 22 tests)
performance_observation.root_cause: Each test independently reloads all inputs and re-runs full breach and watch engine logic over 17,520 records
performance_observation.impact: Does not affect correctness, analytical outputs, or closure readiness

future_optimization_opportunities: Shared module-scoped or session-scoped pytest fixtures for input datasets
Cached input datasets loaded once per test session
Reuse classified outputs between tests instead of recomputing
Avoid repeated full-directory checksum scans in immutability tests
Separate slow integration tests from fast unit tests using pytest markers

terminology_clarification.governed_breach_output_records: All 17,520 source records receive a governed breach classification output
terminology_clarification.actual_breach_events: Only 2,464 records where breach_flag == True (subset of governed output)
terminology_clarification.governed_watch_output_records: All 17,520 source records receive a governed watch evaluation output
terminology_clarification.actual_watch_conditions: Only 9,120 records where watch_condition_flag == True (subset of governed output)

upstream_immutability.method: SHA-256 checksums before and after engine execution
